scenes.say: Your stomach doesn't growl because you're hungry. It's cleaning.
Your gut is always squeezing food along, with waves of muscle.
scenes.heading: YOUR GUT

scenes.say: About two hours after your stomach empties, it starts a cleanup wave, to sweep out leftovers and bacteria.
scenes.heading: 2 HOURS LATER

scenes.say: With no food inside to muffle it, all that air and fluid moving around gets loud.
Which is why it happens right before lunch. But it can growl on a full stomach too. You just hear it less.
scenes.heading: FULL STOMACH?

scenes.say: The growl even has an official name, from ancient Greek. Borborygmi.
scenes.heading: OFFICIAL NAME

scenes.say: And yes, it literally means rumbling.
scenes.heading: IT MEANS

scenes.say: Has your stomach ever growled at the worst moment?
